map.所需齿数 = 单边余量 ÷ 齿升量；切削力 F = 单位切削力 × 切削宽度 ×: Required tooth count = single-side allowance / tooth rise; cutting force F = unit cutting force x cutting width x tooth rise x simultaneously-cutting teeth
map.按单位切削力 250 N/mm²、切削宽度 10 mm、同时工作齿数 3 计算切: With unit cutting force 250 N/mm2, cutting width 10 mm and 3 simultaneously-cutting teeth, compute the broaching force from total chip area, then back-calculate the minimum tool-shank section by the 1.3x safety factor and allowable tensile stress 600 MPa.
map.💡 所需齿数 = 单边余量 ÷ 齿升量；F = 250 N/mm² × 10 m: Tip: Required tooth count = single-side allowance / tooth rise; F = 250 N/mm2 x 10 mm x tooth rise x 3 teeth; shank section by 1.3F / 600 MPa.
map.📚 深度解析：拉刀齿升量与拉削力设计: 📚 In-depth: Broach Tooth Rise and Broaching-Force Design
map.内孔拉刀设计：按单边加工余量与齿升量确定所需齿数，同时兼顾拉刀总长与机床有效行程: Internal-hole broach design: from single-side machining allowance and tooth rise determine the required tooth count, while respecting limits on total broach length and machine effective stroke.
map.拉床选型：由单位切削力与切屑总面积估算拉削力，再按 1.3 倍安全系数换算选型吨: Broaching-machine selection: estimate broaching force from unit cutting force and total chip area, then convert by 1.3x safety factor to tonnage, avoiding stall or tool breakage during broaching.
map.刀杆强度校核：按许用拉应力反推刀杆最小截面积，防止细长刀杆在拉削载荷下被拉断。: Tool-shank strength check: back-calculate the minimum shank cross-section from allowable tensile stress to prevent a slender shank from being pulled apart under broaching load.
map.算例：单边余量 3.0 mm、齿升量 0.06 mm/齿: Example: single-side allowance 3.0 mm, tooth rise 0.06 mm/tooth
map.所需齿数 = ⌈3.0 ÷ 0.06⌉ = 50 齿；切屑总面积 = 10 mm: Required tooth count = ceil(3.0 / 0.06) = 50 teeth; total chip area = 10 mm (cutting width) x 0.06 mm x 3 teeth = 1.8 mm2; broaching force F = 250 N/mm2 x 1.8 mm2 = 450.00 N; with 1.3 safety factor = 585.00 N; minimum shank section = 585 / 600 = 0.97 mm2.
map.齿升量该如何选取？: How to choose the tooth rise?
map.粗拉齿一般 0.06–0.10 mm/齿、精拉齿 0.01–0.03 mm/齿。: Roughing teeth generally 0.06-0.10 mm/tooth, finishing teeth 0.01-0.03 mm/tooth. Larger tooth rise needs fewer teeth but raises per-tooth load, easily chipping the edge and worsening surface finish.
map.单位切削力 250 N/mm² 从哪来？: Where does the unit cutting force 250 N/mm2 come from?
map.按中碳钢拉削的比切削力经验值。铸铁约 180 N/mm²、不锈钢 300–350: It is the empirical specific cutting force for medium-carbon steel broaching. Cast iron about 180 N/mm2, stainless steel 300-350 N/mm2, superalloys higher; replace per workpiece material.
map.同时工作齿数与被拉孔长度和齿距相关，通常为 3–6 齿。本工具按 3 齿取值偏保: The simultaneously-cutting teeth relate to the broached hole length and tooth pitch, usually 3-6 teeth. This tool uses 3 conservatively; with small pitch and long holes it increases, raising cutting force.
map.刀杆截面只有 0.97 mm² 合理吗？: Is a shank section of only 0.97 mm2 reasonable?
map.该值仅是强度条件下的理论下限。实际刀杆截面由刚度、装夹方式与标准规格决定，且需校: This value is only the theoretical lower bound under strength. Actual shank section is set by stiffness, clamping method and standard sizes, and stability under broaching must be checked; the value is usually far larger.
